rows.note: Use 證明 as the all-purpose verb for stating that a fact is true.

example.english: I can certify that what you said is true.
example.traditional: 我可以證明你講嘅係真嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 zing3 ming4 nei5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use 認證 when an official body certifies that a product, service, organization, or person meets a standard.

example.english: The official certification shows this product meets the safety standard, so the authorities certify it.
example.traditional: 呢個產品通過官方認證，證明符合安全標準。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 tung1 gwo3 gun1 fong1 jing6 zing3 zing3 ming4 fu4 hap6 on1 cyun4 biu1 zeon2

rows.note: Use 核證 for formally authenticating or verifying a document or copy, especially in writing.

example.english: Please certify that this copy matches the original.
example.traditional: 請核證呢份副本同正本一致。
example.jyutping: cing2 hat6 zing3 ni1 fan6 fu3 bun2 tung4 zing3 bun2 jat1 zi3
